design_system.name: The Modern Workshop
design_system.description: A precision-engineered design system for hardware management. Combines the reliability of industrial tools with the clarity of Swiss typography. Functional, sturdy, and high-contrast.

key_principles: Data is the Hero: Inventory numbers must be monospaced and high-contrast.
Grid Borders: Visible structure, like a blueprint or shelving unit.
Safety Colors: Use Orange only for alerts/actions, Blue for structure.
Dense & Direct: No unnecessary whitespace in data tables.

rules: All prices, stock counts, and SKUs must use 'JetBrains Mono'.
Labels and overlines must be uppercase, 'text-xs', 'tracking-widest', and 'font-medium'.

primary.description: Slate 900 - Deep, almost black blue. Used for Sidebar, Primary Buttons, Text.

secondary.description: Slate 100 - Used for secondary buttons, card backgrounds.

accent.description: Orange 500 - Safety Orange. Used for 'Low Stock' alerts, 'Add to Cart' actions.

background.description: Slate 50 - Paper white. Not clinical white.

surface.description: Pure white for cards and tables.

usage_rules: Never use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors or subtle noise textures.
Use 'Safety Orange' sparingly. It should scream 'Attention'.
Borders are essential. Use 'border-slate-200' to define structure.

strategies: The 'Control Room' Grid: Dense, data-heavy layouts for the dashboard.
Sidebar Navigation: Fixed width (240px), dark theme ('bg-slate-900').
Cardless Tables: Use 'border-b' for rows, remove outer card borders for a cleaner look.

inputs.style: rounded-sm border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:border-transparent font-mono text-sm

badges.style: rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono font-medium

textures: Grid Pattern: 'bg-[linear-gradient(to_right,#80808012_1px,transparent_1px),linear-gradient(to_bottom,#80808012_1px,transparent_1px)] bg-[size:24px_24px]' for dashboard background.

login_background.description: Wall with tools - Use for Login/Register split screen background.

dashboard_texture.description: Tools on wood - Use for 'Welcome' widget or promo banner.

user_avatar_placeholder.description: Warehouse worker - Default avatar for staff.

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons. Use 'Package', 'Wrench', 'Hammer', 'ShoppingCart', 'Users', 'BarChart3' heavily.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA (4.5:1). Use Slate 900 on Slate 50/100.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-slate-900) are mandatory for keyboard navigation.
accessibility.aria_labels: All icon-only buttons must have aria-label.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: You are building a professional tool, not a toy. Prioritize density and information hierarchy over whitespace. Use the 'Grid Pattern' background for the main dashboard area to give it a technical feel.
instructions_to_main_agent.layout_implementation: Use a Sidebar Layout with a fixed left sidebar (w-64) and a scrollable main content area. The main content area should have the 'Grid Pattern' background.
instructions_to_main_agent.component_usage: Use Shadcn UI components but override the rounded corners to 'rounded-sm' or 'rounded-md' to match the industrial aesthetic. Do not use 'rounded-xl' or 'rounded-2xl'.
instructions_to_main_agent.charts: Use 'recharts' with the custom color palette (Slate 900 for primary data, Orange 500 for alerts).
instructions_to_main_agent.tables: Tables are the heart of this app. Make them dense ('p-2' cells) and use 'JetBrains Mono' for all numerical data (Price, Stock, SKU).

do_not: Do not use gradients for buttons or backgrounds.
Do not use rounded-full for buttons (except badges).
Do not center text in tables (except status badges).
must_do: Must use 'data-testid' for all interactive elements.
Must implement a responsive sidebar that collapses on mobile.
